thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: infra-oncall // Severity: page // Message: Repeated GPU Xid(13) + ECC parity errors observed on gpu-node-17 causing container restarts and kernel oops. Link: https://internal.incidents/2137654321

jess (oncall): I'm up. seeing ~20 Xid(13) in last 10m, spikes line up with long seq-length serving requests.

sam (eng-runtime): confirming — kernel + driver logs show: 
```
[  +0.000123] NVRM: Xid (13): 0x00000000
[  +0.001234] kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU-crash dump process...
[  +0.002345] containerd: container restart
```

maya (sre): recommend cordon + drain node to stop noisy restarts and avoid cascading OOMs.

jess (oncall): Agreed. I'll cordon then drain; will handle PDB overrides if eviction blocks.

jess (oncall): `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` -> OK, node cordoned.

jess (oncall): `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` -> evicting pods; a few pods failed due to local volume mounts, forcing deletion.

lee (support): Which customers are impacted? SLO dashboards show 6 live inference routes with increased 5–7% 500s.

sam (eng-runtime): Routed critical customers to cpu-inference pool as short-term mitigation; updated route policy to prefer cpu-pool when node health is degraded.

deploy-bot: Route policy rollout started (rollout-id: r-8674) triggered by sam.

maya (sre): Once drains complete, we should reboot the node to clear ECC state and check nv-host diagnostics.

jess (oncall): Rebooting now: `ssh admin@gpu-node-17 sudo reboot` — node unreachable at +38s.

sam (eng-runtime): Node came back but kernel shows repeated ECC parity messages; `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` shows rising Uncorrectable counts on GPU1. Driver continues to reset.

maya (sre): Removing node from rotation permanently for now and opening vendor support/RMA. We don't want further noisy resets.

lee (support): Drafting customer status: "We are seeing degraded inference performance for a subset of requests; traffic has been shifted to a CPU fallback pool while we investigate hardware faults."

jess (oncall): Created incident ticket INC-2137654321 and attached initial logs and mitigation steps.

sam (eng-runtime): Suggested next steps: hard power-cycle GPU, reflash driver (current 535.86), migrate remaining workloads off host, and start hardware RMA if parity persists.

maya (sre): Marking incident P1 -> active mitigation. Handoff to sam for deep dive and vendor coordination. @sam you're on.

jess (oncall): Handoff notes: node-17 cordoned/drained; routing fallback active; customers notified on status page. I'm entering shift change in 15m but available if needed.

sam (eng-runtime): Taking over. Collecting extended logs: `journalctl -u nvidia-driver.service -n 500` and `dmesg | grep -i nvrm`. Opening ENG-HW ticket and starting RMA request.

lee (support): Can we confirm ETA for a customer-facing update? Requesting a follow-up note in 30m with RMA plan.

sam (eng-runtime): Will send 30m update with vendor timeline and mitigation permanence. Adding runbook steps to the incident doc.

maya (sre): Action items: schedule RMA, keep node cordoned, add alert for ECC uncorrectable > 5 in 5m, and review routing policy to isolate single-node hardware faults quicker.

jess (oncall): :thumbsup: Closing the page for me, handing active control to sam and maya.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 2137654321 — node removed from rotation; severity downgraded to partial degradation for a subset of traffic; next update scheduled in 30m.

sam (eng-runtime): Follow-up note: root cause appears to be intermittent ECC parity failures on GPU1 causing driver resets and subsequent container crashes. Hardware RMA pending. Postmortem will cover earlier detection and isolation improvements.

lee (support): Logged customer notifications in STATUS-3217 and created follow-up tasks for updates.

maya (sre): Collating timeline, kernel oops, and nv-host dumps into the incident doc: https://incidents/docs/2137654321 — tagging eng-hw and eng-platform for next steps.

sam (eng-runtime): I'll coordinate vendor RMA and routing improvements; will post next update in 30m.
